hardware.variant: One assembled kit with operator-reported CoreBoard V1.2.

inputs.name: ESP_MOSAICO RAM kernel FIT with display and controller diagnostics
Static FFS RAM root with LVGL

scenario: Boot the diagnostic kernel and RAM root, read framebuffer and GPIO/SPI snapshots, start the LVGL wscons example, and check visible output.
expected: The example produces a visible interface and the driver reports successful refresh activity.
observed: The initial framebuffer scan reported rows_changed=480, rows_sent=480, errors=0 and last_error=0. After starting LVGL and a three-second wait, both row counters were 961 with no errors; the process remained alive. GPIO output and enable registers programmed the shared active-low supply on and panel reset released. Pin routing matched the V1.2 device tree. GPSPI reported clkrst=00800043, gate=00000003, clock=80000000, user=08002040, user1=00400000, misc=0000003e and int_raw=00001000, confirming the configured one-clock CS hold phase. The operator still reported a completely black screen; adding CS hold did not resolve the visible-output failure.
limits: One sample and a short RAM trial; the installed NOR image was not updated.
Successful SPI completion and row counters do not prove the panel received valid commands or pixels.
Register snapshots describe programmed state, not measured pad voltage or physical bus timing.
This trial did not repeat the separately recorded touch-input check or establish calibration, camera, audio or Wi-Fi operation.
Raw UART logs and local device identifiers remain private.
